summary: Fixes the actual bounded geometric domain from qualified G331, retaining all supports and conductor fibres, with n−1 potential entries and an explicit degree-n component convention. No product theorem is imported.
detailedSummary: Uses only G331's independently defined Cartier-positive core, its uniform comparison, actual decreasing-net completion, compact boundary, density, gauge changes and full descent. Bounded inputs must belong to that actual geometric completion; zero and mixed-zero inputs are admitted, while all inputs with unbounded or bottom values are excluded. Dimension zero is empty and dimension one has zero potential entries.
text:
Let (R,m) be an excellent reduced local ring of dimension n>0 and fix a proper m-primary ideal a. Write X_a={v:v(a)=1}, retaining every centred real semivaluation support, including nonminimal supports and supports on the conductor quotient. Primary ideal values are finite positive continuous functions on this compact Hausdorff space.

The sole incoming correctness/source grant is qualified G331, including its entire source, mandatory annotation, source ledger and exact scope. It defines positivity before ideal closure, using actual negative effective finite REAL Cartier presentations on actual primary blowups and nonnegative degree on every contracted proper integral curve. It proves C_geom=C_ideal and D_geom=D_ideal. Here C is the uniform closure of finite nonnegative real combinations of negative primary-or-unit ideal values, and D consists of infima of ACTUAL nonempty decreasing C-nets. No envelope, product, intersection, locality, energy or arbitrary-model cofinality result is imported.

The input domain is D_a^bd={u in D:-M≤u≤0 for some finite M}. Membership in D remains mandatory. Thus the construction below covers arbitrary real continuous C inputs and bounded completed inputs, including permitted zero and mixed-zero patterns; it does not declare every bounded nonpositive function geometric. Inputs with any −∞ value, including bottom, and unbounded inputs are excluded. If g_alpha decreases to u≥−M, each representing term already lies in [−M,0], so no unproved truncation or completion operation is needed.

Set p=n−1. A measure has p potential entries; its test supplies the nth intersection entry. All multiplicities below use the degree-n part of the primary length polynomial. In a non-equidimensional ring, lower-dimensional components remain in the boundary and function class but contribute zero in this convention. Separate products on those components would require their separate dimension-dependent arities. Dimension one has zero potentials and a reference measure. Dimension zero has empty centred boundary and the unique zero measure, without negative arity.

Two functional results of G331 are used. Rational profiles −v(I)/k, with the unit ideal allowed, are uniformly dense in C. The rational difference span of ideal gauges is uniformly dense in all real continuous functions on X_a. After synchronizing denominators, a span element is (v(J)−v(K))/k. The identity min(v(I)−v(J),v(K)−v(H))=v(IH+KJ)−v(JH) gives the lattice property. Rational constants come from v(a)=1. The truncations v((f)+a^N)=min(v(f),N) separate all semivaluations, including infinite coordinates. G331's compact lattice argument therefore supplies density on the entire boundary, not a finite grid.

For finite normalization, G331 retains all local normal centres and FULL restriction fibres. Fibres are singletons at finite conductor value; at infinite conductor value they are precisely the conductor-quotient identification fibres. Both completed geometric classes descend exactly when constant on these whole fibres. The normalization identities below are applied to actual downstairs inputs and their pullbacks, without selecting lifts or deleting an infinity stratum.

Nilpotents are reduced away. No unreduced generic-length information is recovered from these boundary data. General finite-map geometric operators and energy remain separate P12.6 and P12.5 targets.

Artifacts: n1.md, argument.md, and the unchanged G331 source/annotation/ledger under inputs/mathematical. Rerun source retention with python audit_inputs.py. All 31 explicitly bound mathematical/primary files matched their supplied sizes and SHA-256 hashes. Retention and hashing do not establish mathematical correctness or whole-source reading.
